clips.prompt: a grey water buffalo grazing alone on a grassy field edge beside green rice paddies in golden afternoon light, bamboo grove behind
clips.voice: Tan học, mình chỉ chờ có một việc thôi, là dắt trâu ra đồng.

clips.prompt: first-person view of a village gate made of bamboo, a 10-year-old boy in a faded brown shirt and rolled-up trousers seen from behind leading a grey water buffalo by a rope out along an earthen path, afternoon
clips.voice: Quăng cái cặp lên giường, mình dắt con trâu nhà ra khỏi ngõ.

clips.prompt: a 10-year-old boy in a faded brown shirt seen from behind walking barefoot on a narrow earthen path between rice fields leading a grey water buffalo, other boys with buffaloes ahead, golden light
clips.voice: Lũ bạn trong xóm cũng ra cả, mỗi đứa một con, đi hàng dài trên bờ ruộng.

clips.prompt: a 10-year-old boy in a faded brown shirt seen from behind sitting on the back of a grey water buffalo in a green field, a conical hat on his head, golden afternoon light
clips.voice: Mình leo lên lưng trâu ngồi, đung đưa, thấy mình oai như ông tướng, bạn nhỉ.

clips.prompt: close-up of a boy's hands holding a sickle cutting green grass into a bamboo basket at the edge of a rice field, no face
clips.voice: Rồi tranh thủ cắt một gánh cỏ đầy, để tối về trâu có cái ăn.

clips.prompt: several village boys seen from behind playing on a grassy field, one kicking a ball made of straw, buffaloes grazing in the background, golden light
clips.voice: Trâu gặm cỏ, cả bọn bày trò đá bóng rơm, đánh khăng, chơi đến quên cả giờ.

clips.prompt: village boys seen from behind gathered around a small straw fire at the edge of a harvested field, roasting sweet potatoes, smoke rising, evening light
clips.voice: Có hôm đốt rơm nướng khoai, khoai cháy đen mà ăn ngon nhớ đời.

clips.prompt: a grey water buffalo half submerged in a village pond, a boy seen from behind splashing water on its back, evening light reflected on the water
clips.voice: Chiều muộn, dắt trâu xuống ao tắm, nước mát rượi, trâu lim dim mắt.

clips.prompt: a 10-year-old boy seen from behind riding a grey water buffalo home along the earthen path at sunset, carrying a basket of grass, rice fields glowing orange
clips.voice: Mặt trời lặn, mình cưỡi trâu về, gánh cỏ đung đưa bên hông.

clips.prompt: a thatched village house at dusk, smoke from the kitchen, a mother in a brown blouse seen from behind waiting at the bamboo gate
clips.voice: Đầu ngõ, mẹ đã đứng chờ, khói bếp bay lên mái rạ.

clips.prompt: the same rice fields today with a modern harvesting machine and concrete roads, no buffaloes, soft evening light
clips.voice: Giờ ra đồng toàn máy móc, chẳng còn mấy ai nuôi trâu nữa.

clips.prompt: an old wooden buffalo yoke and a worn rope hanging on a mud wall today, soft evening light
clips.voice: Nhưng lưng trâu buổi chiều ấy, gánh cỏ đầy ấy, làm sao mà quên được.
